title: A cold, massive, rotating disk galaxy 1.5 billion years after the Big Bang
question: Is the absorption-selected galaxy DLA0817g at z=4.26 a rotationally supported cold disk, and what are its dynamical and molecular masses?

data.bands: [C II] tuned at 361.312 GHz, plus three continuum bands, each 1.875 GHz wide
data.sensitivity: continuum 23 uJy/beam (natural), 27 uJy/beam (robust 0.5); cube 0.35 mJy/beam per 25 km/s (natural)

what.value: Lower-resolution ALMA [C II] and continuum measurements for comparison

evidence.loc: Far-Infrared Continuum, [C II] Line, and CO(2-1) Line Luminosities.
evidence.quote: These measurements are consistent with the values obtained from the lower-resolution measurement(cite: Neeleman2017)
We therefore assume r$_{\,2,1} =$ 0.81, as determined from these galaxies.

recipe.method: Pipeline calibration, extra flagging, tclean continuum and cubes
Flux within 1.5" radius per channel, integrate over line channels; 2D Gaussian fits for size
assumptions: TIR from modified blackbody with Td=35 K, beta=1.6

recipe.goal: Fit rotating disk model to [C II] cube
recipe.method: Thin exponential disk with constant (or arctan) rotation, constant dispersion, convolved with beam, MCMC fit to cube
assumptions: Infinitely thin disk; thick disk tested

recipe.goal: Derive rotation curves, dynamical mass, Toomre Q
recipe.method: Mean-velocity and peak-velocity rotation curves; Mdyn = 2.32e5 v^2 R; Q averaged over R=3Rd
CMB-corrected CO flux to L'CO, then r21 and alpha_CO

evidence.quote: an inclination-corrected rotational velocity of $v_{\rm rot}$ = 272$^{+52}_{-13}$ km s$^{-1}$

evidence.loc: Far-Infrared Continuum, [C II] Line, and CO(2-1) Line Luminosities.
evidence.quote: The total velocity-integrated [C II] flux density from DLA0817g is 5.8 $\pm$ 0.4 Jy km s$^{-1}$

evidence.loc: Far-Infrared Continuum, [C II] Line, and CO(2-1) Line Luminosities.

not_stated_but_needed: Line-free channel ranges for continuum and uvcontsub order
tclean cell size, image size, masks, cleaning threshold, iterations
MCMC priors, walker number, chain length, convergence criteria
Channel range used for the velocity-integrated [C II] map
Radial bin sizes for rotation curves
missing_for_reproduction: Exact tclean parameters and line-free channels
score_reason: Public data, released code, and numeric results, but imaging and fit settings are only partly given.
rediscovery_reason: Public ALMA data, released code, numeric kinematic results; some settings need inference.
